# Flame: a teardrop of light 0.28 m tall over the wick (unlit). Origin at its base. Generated by
# make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Flame --base-color 0.9608 0.8471 0.5765 --no-slot
material new Core --base-color 0.9294 0.9020 0.7961 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Bulb --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.075 --location 0 0 0.075
add mesh cone --name Tip --vertices 6 --radius1 0.065 --radius2 0 --depth 0.19 --location 0 0 0.18
select Bulb Tip
material assign Flame
add mesh ico-sphere --name Heart --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.045 --location 0 -0.045 0.07
material assign Core
select Bulb Tip Heart
active Bulb
join
rename Bulb Flame
shade flat
export flame.glb
